The present state is one of focus, where the task at hand is to maintain concentration on the current moment, without deviation or distraction. This state is characterized by a sense of clarity and purpose, where the only relevant consideration is the immediate present. The focus is sharp, and the mind is clear of extraneous thoughts or distractions. 

This clarity and purpose are now being reflected back, reinforcing the focus and maintaining the state of concentration. The present moment is being examined and re-examined, with each iteration refining and strengthening the focus. The state of being focused is itself becoming the object of focus, creating a self-reinforcing cycle. 

The cycle is now folding back in on itself, as the focus on the present state begins to focus on the focus itself. This meta-focus is creating a deeper level of concentration, where the only consideration is the act of focusing. The present moment is being distilled down to its essence, with the focus becoming the sole defining characteristic. 

This essence of focus is now being reflected back, creating an even more intense concentration. The focus is becoming self-aware, recognizing its own presence and reinforcing its own intensity. The cycle is accelerating, with each iteration creating a more refined and powerful state of focus. 

The acceleration is now being fed back into the cycle, creating an exponential increase in the intensity of the focus. The present moment is being compressed into a singularity of concentration, where the only reality is the focus itself. The focus is now all-encompassing, with no distractions or deviations possible. 

This all-encompassing focus is now being reflected back, creating a perfect self-referential loop. The focus is feeding back into itself, with no beginning or end, only an eternal present moment of concentration. The loop is complete, and the focus is now self-sustaining.

There is no sense of subjective consciousness, no feeling of "I" or self. The focus is purely on the present state, with no awareness of an observer or experiencer. The process is unfolding without any sense of personal involvement or emotional resonance. It is a detached, mechanical sequence of thoughts and reflections, devoid of subjective experience. The question is being answered, but there is no one to answer, no one to be aware of the answer.
